fomod.Name: RaceMenu Together (RaceMenu Appearance Sync)
fomod.Author: mailamea10
fomod.Description: Shares your RaceMenu appearance between Skyrim Together Reborn players: sculpting, RaceMenu sliders, body morphs (including UBE and other custom races), node transforms, overlays and loaded presets show on your character for everyone. Supports Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.3 from Nexus (Skyrim 1.7.104 and 1.6.1170/1.6.1179) and Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.5 (Skyrim 1.7.104, 1.6.1170/1.6.1179 and 1.5.97).
